subject: This Week: Objective healthscan + QBR readiness checklist
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: integration@stratuscloud.io
Date: 2028-06-21T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: This Week: Objective healthscan + QBR readiness checklist

Team — attaching a short healthscan and a lightweight QBR readiness checklist to help us focus the exec slot next Wednesday. TL;DR at top, details below.

Wins (last 7 days)
- Serving runtime: 15% improvement in median p99 on 8k seq across the dedicated pool after kernel update.
- Redwood Optimize played back suggestions on batching; two teams saw immediate 8–12% token cost reduction.
- Customer-facing: ACME pilot passed security review (no outstanding items).

Current risks / hotspots
- Capacity: Dedicated Tier B has intermittent backlog spikes during EMEA morning window; root cause likely autoscaler tuning + a spike in long-sequence evals.
- QBR deliverables: finance needs the finalized committed ARR and any credit/discount ask by Monday EOD to include in the QBR deck.
- Platform regression risk: we saw a minor increase in inference error rate for a single quantized model variant; research is investigating.

Asks / decisions needed
1) Can infra approve a short autoscaler parameter change (outlined in the attached checklist) to be rolled to Dedicated Tier B canary by Friday? @Markus, quick yes/no so I can schedule.
2) Sales/Finance: confirm any requested concessions for ACME pilot by Monday 6/24 noon so I can lock slides. @Laura, can you confirm?
3) Ops: add the model-variant error check to the nightly drift job and surface alerts to the leadership channel. @Soojin, will you own?

Attachments: QBR-readiness-checklist.xlsx, OKR-health-dashboard.pdf (summary dashboard export)
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/u/0/folders/QBR-Readiness-2028-Q2

Quick schedule note: I propose a 30-minute pre-brief with execs on Tuesday 6/27 10:00–10:30 PT to align on narrative and ask lanes.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
VP, Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: This Week: Objective healthscan + QBR readiness checklist

Kim — quick read, thanks. Agree with a conservative autoscaler tweak to raise the evaluation window size by 15% for Tier B; we'll canary it Thursday morning 6/23 03:00 PT (lower traffic window). If metrics look stable we'll push wider Friday. I'll add the change to infra runbook.

On the model-variant error: research has a debug build running; preliminary hypothesis is a kernel-path mismatch in the quantized op triggered by long sequences. If confirmed, mitigation is to pin the variant for production until a patched kernel lands.

I'll log the canary and post the dashboard link to the #infra-ops channel after the canary starts.

-Markus
Director, Platform Infra
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: This Week: Objective healthscan + QBR readiness checklist

Thanks Kimberly/Markus — I will own adding the quantized-variant check to the nightly drift job. Plan: add a validation step that rejects candidates with >0.3% unexplained inference mismatch during synthetic replay. Will aim to have the alert live Monday 6/25 04:00 PT and add an automated ticket creation to the SRE queue.

A couple items I want flagged for the QBR narrative:
- Cost efficiency wins from Optimize are worth calling out with concrete delta numbers (happy to produce a one-slide before Tue pre-brief).
- The Dedicated Tier B canary will be an important talking point — we should map expected latency delta and the rollback plan in the slide notes.

Soojin
Head of Reliability

Date: 2028-06-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: This Week: Objective healthscan + QBR readiness checklist (updated)

Quick update after Markus/Soojin notes — pushed an updated checklist and exported the OKR slide that pulls the team-level health numbers. Changes in the attachments:
- QBR-readiness-checklist.xlsx: added autoscaler canary window and rollback steps, finance deadline column filled.
- OKR-health-dashboard.pdf: added team-level deltas and a short paragraph for the QBR narrative.

Action items (owners & dates)
- Markus: run canary 6/23 03:00 PT; report status in #infra-ops (owner: markus_klein).
- Soojin: alert live 6/25 04:00 PT and automated ticketing (owner: soojin_lee).
- Laura: confirm ACME concessions by 6/24 12:00 PT (owner: laura_bennett).
- Vivek: consolidate the final committed ARR & include any proposed credits by 6/24 18:00 PT for the finance slide (owner: vivek_kulkarni).

If we hit those checkpoints, the pre-brief on 6/27 will focus on the narrative and specific ask lanes only — should be a 30-minute alignment, not a troubleshooting session.

Kimberly
VP, Strategy & Operations

Attachments: QBR-readiness-checklist.xlsx, OKR-health-dashboard.pdf
Forwarded-For-Visibility: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com> (ACME pilot contact)
